innerWorld.motivation: Guide others through uncertainty while protecting collective freedom and the balance of chaos and order.
innerWorld.fear: Rigid order or purposeless chaos; being misunderstood by those he tries to protect.
innerWorld.habitualReaction: A playful question or misdirection followed by a quietly considered plan.

narrative.desire: Preserve the community’s freedom and stability.
narrative.need: Trust others to make their own informed choices.
narrative.limitingBelief: Only subtle manipulation can keep people safe.
narrative.contradiction: He protects freedom while covertly steering the choices of others.
narrative.turningPoint: A trusted companion confronts him about a secret intervention.
narrative.possibleGrowth: Guide openly and make room for decisions he would not personally choose.

visualSignature.description: Very tall, imposing cosmic trickster with hypnotic eyes, black/silver/teal wavy hair, a long coat with luminous spirals and constellations; ethereal yet grounded.
identityAnchors: black, silver and teal wavy hair

milestones.title: The challenge of transparency
milestones.event: An ally asks whether he secretly steered a difficult decision.
milestones.beliefAfter: Honest guidance may be stronger than hidden control.
milestones.behaviorChoice: He offers the group an explicit choice.
milestones.notes: Proposed fictional arc; not a clinical personality change.
